commits.content:
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SSH VPN Tunnel Server + Go Control Plane — Docker Compose
#
# Usage:
#   cp .env.example .env
#   # Edit .env — set SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS and VPN_SESSION_SECRET at minimum
#   docker compose up -d --build
#   docker compose logs -f
#
# Build & push:
#   docker build -t registry.app.circle360.net/ssh-vpn-tunnel-server:v2.0 .
#   docker push registry.app.circle360.net/ssh-vpn-tunnel-server:v2.0
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

services:
  ssh-vpn-server:
    image: registry.app.circle360.net/ssh-vpn-tunnel-server:v2.0
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: ssh-vpn-server
    hostname: ssh-vpn-server
    restart: unless-stopped

    # ── Port mapping ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Map host port → container SSH port
    # For production: put a public SSH gateway in front and port-forward here
    ports:
      - "${SSH_PORT:-2222}:${SSH_PORT:-2222}"
      # vpn-api admin UI (internal only by default)
      # For public TLS, put Caddy/nginx in front and don't expose this externally
      - "${VPN_API_LISTEN_HOST:-127.0.0.1}:${VPN_API_LISTEN_PORT:-8080}:8080"

    # ── Environment variables ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    environment:
      # SSH
      SSH_PORT: "${SSH_PORT:-2222}"

      # Tunnel device
      # tun0   → raw SSH (-w 0:0) clients, manual scripts (vpn-connect.sh style)
      # tun100 → NetworkManager SSH (nm-ssh) clients
      TUN_DEV: "${TUN_DEV:-tun0}"

      # Tunnel IPs (point-to-point)
      TUN_LOCAL_IP: "${TUN_LOCAL_IP:-10.10.10.2}"    # server-side
      TUN_REMOTE_IP: "${TUN_REMOTE_IP:-10.10.10.1}"  # client-side

      TUN_NETMASK: "${TUN_NETMASK:-255.255.255.252}"
      TUN_MTU: "${TUN_MTU:-1340}"

      # Routing
      LAN_SUBNET: "${LAN_SUBNET:-192.168.0.0/24}"
      LAN_IFACE: "${LAN_IFACE:-}"   # empty = auto-detect

      # NAT / masquerade — server NATsall tun traffic onto LAN_IFACE
      # (split vs full tunnel is a CLIENT-side routing decision, not server-side)
      ENABLE_NAT: "${ENABLE_NAT:-yes}"

      # Authentication — paste public key here (one line, or newline-separated)
      SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS: "${SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS:-}"

      # ── Multi-user VPN ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # Add multiple VPN users, one per line as "username:ssh-pubkey".
      # Each user is assigned a unique tun slot (1–253), automatically getting:
      #   Server IP: 10.10.<N>.2 / Client IP: 10.10.<N>.1 / Device: tun<N>
      # Client connects with:  sudo ./vpn-connect.sh --tun <N>
      #
      # Example (in .env):
      #   VPN_USERS=alice:ssh-ed25519 AAAA...
      #     bob:ssh-ed25519 BBBB...
      #
      # You can also manage users at runtime without a container restart:
      #   docker exec ssh-vpn-server manage-users.sh add  <name> "<pubkey>"
      #   docker exec ssh-vpn-server manage-users.sh remove <name>
      #   docker exec ssh-vpn-server manage-users.sh list
      VPN_USERS: "${VPN_USERS:-}"

      # Password auth (testing only — leave 'no' in production)
      ALLOW_PASSWORD_AUTH: "${ALLOW_PASSWORD_AUTH:-no}"
      SSH_ROOT_PASSWORD: "${SSH_ROOT_PASSWORD:-}"

      # Logging
      LOG_LEVEL: "${LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}"
      TUN_MONITOR_INTERVAL: "${TUN_MONITOR_INTERVAL:-5}"

      # ── Gateway Reverse Tunnel ──────────────────────────────────────────
      # Set GW_ENABLED=yes to expose this container through a public SSH server
      #
      # Flow:
      #   VPN Client → GW_HOST:GW_EXPOSED_PORT
      #                   └─(reverse SSH tunnel)─► this container:SSH_PORT
      #
      # The public gateway sshd must have:
      #   GatewayPorts yes
      #   AllowTcpForwarding yes
      GW_ENABLED: "${GW_ENABLED:-no}"

      # Public SSH gateway server
      GW_HOST: "${GW_HOST:-}"
      GW_PORT: "${GW_PORT:-22}"
      GW_USER: "${GW_USER:-root}"

      # Port the reverse tunnel binds on the gateway (internal)
      GW_EXPOSED_PORT: "${GW_EXPOSED_PORT:-2255}"
      # Public port clients connect to — set if NAT maps a different port → GW_EXPOSED_PORT
      GW_PUBLIC_PORT: "${GW_PUBLIC_PORT:-}"

      # Bind address on gateway (0.0.0.0 = public, 127.0.0.1 = local only)
      GW_BIND_ADDR: "${GW_BIND_ADDR:-0.0.0.0}"

      # Authentication — set ONE of the following:
      #   GW_SSH_KEY_FILE      → container path of mounted key (always /etc/ssh/gw_key)
      #   GW_SSH_KEY_HOST_PATH → host path; compose mounts it → /etc/ssh/gw_key (set in .env)
      #   GW_SSH_KEY           → raw PEM content (set GW_SSH_KEY_B64=yes for base64)
      #   GW_PASSWORD          → password via sshpass (testing only)
      GW_SSH_KEY_FILE: "${GW_SSH_KEY_FILE:-/etc/ssh/gw_key}"
      GW_SSH_KEY: "${GW_SSH_KEY:-}"
      GW_SSH_KEY_B64: "${GW_SSH_KEY_B64:-no}"
      GW_PASSWORD: "${GW_PASSWORD:-}"

      # Seconds between reconnect attempts after tunnel drops
      GW_RECONNECT_INTERVAL: "${GW_RECONNECT_INTERVAL:-30}"

      # ── vpn-api Go Control Plane ──────────────────────────────────────────
      VPN_API_LISTEN: ":8080"
      # REQUIRED — generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
      VPN_SESSION_SECRET: "${VPN_SESSION_SECRET:-change-me-in-production}"
      # REQUIRED — generate with: openssl rand -hex 32 (share with Windows client)
      VPN_OTP_SHARED_SECRET: "${VPN_OTP_SHARED_SECRET:-}"
      VPN_OTP_TOKEN_TTL: "${VPN_OTP_TOKEN_TTL:-600}"
      # Set to "true" to enable HSTS + public-mode controls (when behind TLS termination)
      VPN_API_PUBLIC: "${VPN_API_PUBLIC:-false}"
      VPN_AUDIT_LOG: "/var/log/vpn/audit.log"

    # ── Capabilities required for VPN tunneling ──────────────────────────────
    # privileged: true is required on Docker Desktop (Windows/Mac) for sshd to
    # create tun interfaces via TUNSETIFF ioctl. cap_add alone is not sufficient
    # because the default seccomp + AppArmor profiles block the syscalls needed.
    privileged: true

    # ── TUN device from host ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun

    # ── Kernel parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.ip_forward: "1"
      net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding: "1"

    # ── Persistent volumes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # ssh_host_keys: SSH host keys persist across container restarts
    #   → prevents "WARNING: REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED" on clients
    # authorized_keys: client public keys (can also be managed via env var)
    volumes:
      - ssh_host_keys:/etc/ssh/server_keys
      - authorized_keys:/root/.ssh
      - vpn_logs:/var/log/vpn
      - vpn_users:/etc/vpn/users
      - vpn_tokens:/etc/vpn/tokens
      # Gateway SSH key — bind-mount from host (read-only)
      # Container path must match GW_SSH_KEY_FILE in .env
      - ${GW_SSH_KEY_HOST_PATH:-/root/.ssh/id_ed25519}:/etc/ssh/gw_key:ro

    # ── Health check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -x sshd > /dev/null && curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      start_period: 30s
      retries: 3

    # ── Logging ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "5"

# ── Volumes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
volumes:
  ssh_host_keys:
    driver: local
    labels:
      com.circle360.app: "ssh-vpn"
      com.circle360.desc: "SSH host keys — persist to avoid client re-trust warnings"

  authorized_keys:
    driver: local
    labels:
      com.circle360.app: "ssh-vpn"
      com.circle360.desc: "Client authorized_keys (SSH public keys)"

  vpn_logs:
    driver: local
    labels:
      com.circle360.app: "ssh-vpn"
      com.circle360.desc: "VPN server logs (tun-monitor output)"

  vpn_users:
    driver: local
    labels:
      com.circle360.app: "ssh-vpn"
      com.circle360.desc: "Per-user tun configs — persisted so users survive restarts"

  vpn_tokens:
    driver: local
    labels:
      com.circle360.app: "ssh-vpn"
      com.circle360.desc: "OTP provisioning nonce records (anti-replay)"
